args: variants --reference-id ref --gff stdin
stdin: ref.gff
exit: 1
--- stderr
Error: only one input can be read from stdin, but --query and --gff are both stdin
Usage:
  gofasta variants [flags]

Flags:
  -q, --query string          Alignment of the sequences to annotate, in fasta format (default "stdin")
  -r, --reference string      Reference sequence, in a fasta file of its own, the same width as the --query alignment (required without an annotation, unless --reference-id)
      --reference-id string   ID of the reference record in the --query alignment (instead of --reference)
  -a, --annotation string     GenBank or GFF3 annotation file, with suffix: .gb, .gbk, .gbff, .gff or .gff3 [.gz]
      --genbank string        GenBank annotation file, with any file extension (instead of --annotation)
      --gff string            GFF3 annotation file, with any file extension (instead of --annotation)
  -o, --outfile string        Where to write the variants (default "stdout")
      --start int             Only report mutations with a reference base at or after this position
      --end int               Only report mutations with a reference base at or before this position
      --aggregate             Report the frequency of each mutation
      --threshold float       If --aggregate, only report mutations with a freq greater than or equal to this value
      --append-snps           Report the codon's SNPs in parenthesis after each amino acid change
      --group-aa              Report the amino acid changes from one indel as one entry (aa:S:HV69-- instead of aa:S:H69-|aa:S:V70-)
      --strict                Stop with an error at the first record that can't be processed, instead of warning and skipping it
  -t, --threads int           Number of threads (and CPUs) to use (with no flag, all CPUs are used)
  -h, --help                  help for variants
